piezas.ilustracion_alt: Diptych split by a vertical line. On the left, “Nov. 2025”: a slide with a play triangle and a padlock, labelled “Video locked”. On the right, “Today”: the same slide, in blue, with lines of text and a pencil, labelled “Editable”.
piezas.titular: NotebookLM presentations, once impossible to tweak, can now be revised slide by slide
piezas.entradilla: A year ago, anyone wanting an editable presentation had to leave NotebookLM. Today the tool, which no longer even goes by that name, makes slides, amends them on request and exports them to PowerPoint.
cuerpo: On 7 November 2025, in ChatGPT-IA-edu, someone asked whether NotebookLM could be made to use their own images in a presentation. The answer captured the limit at the time: NotebookLM made video presentations, which could not be modified once created, and anyone who wanted slides to present and tweak had to turn to Gemini.

Weeks later, slide decks arrived, as Google recalled on 16 December in «[8 ways to make the most out of Slide Decks in NotebookLM](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/google-labs/8-ways-to-make-the-most-out-of-slide-decks-in-notebooklm)». On 20 March 2026, the [Google Workspace Updates](https://workspaceupdates.googleblog.com/2026/03/new-ways-to-customize-and-interact-with-your-content-in-NotebookLM.html) blog announced that users could send comments on style or content for each slide and that the presentation could be exported as PPTX as well as PDF.

On 16 July, the tool was renamed [Gemini Notebook](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/products/gemini-notebook/notebooklm-gemini-notebook/). And on 19 October Google explained in «[How to shape your slides and videos with Gemini Notebook](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/products/gemini-notebook/co-create-slides-videos/)» that it suggests topics based on the sources and lets users review the plan before generating the slides or the video. The question from a year ago is no longer whether anything can be changed, but how much it is wise to leave in its hands.

repaso: «solo hacía presentaciones en vídeo» pasa a «hacía»: el mensaje no dice «solo»
quitada la mención a Presentaciones de Google (era de las hechas con Gemini y no se necesitaba)
«indicaciones de estilo o de contenido» pasa a «comentarios de estilo o de contenido» (la fuente dice feedback estilístico o factual)
«desde el 19 de octubre» pasa a «el 19 de octubre Google explicaba»: es la fecha del artículo, no de la función
«revisar el guion» pasa a «revisar el plan»: la fuente habla de notas del esquema y del productor, no de guion
piezas.comprobado: Mensaje 41850 de ChatGPTedu comprobado en t.me (7-11-2025, texto y tema correctos, sin nombres en la pieza). Fuentes abiertas: blog de Google del 16-12-2025 (Slide Decks llegadas «unas semanas» antes, sin fecha exacta; no menciona exportación); Workspace Updates del 20-3-2026 (comentarios por diapositiva y exportación a PPTX además de PDF); blog.google del 16-7-2026 (cambio de nombre a Gemini Notebook); blog.google del 19-10-2026 (propone temas desde las fuentes y conmutador de revisión del plan antes de generar). No se afirma si el texto del PPTX es editable. Sin enlaces a piezas propias; el contraste (vídeo no editable frente a diapositivas revisables y exportables) es real.
